prompts.label: 엠퍼러 슈트
prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input Image 1 is the edit target, an EMPEROR fantasy game equipment illustration.
Change ONLY the background and presentation margin. Preserve this exact equipment design, construction, number of pieces, gold/obsidian/platinum materials, crimson insets, white-gold solar cores, engraving, perspective, proportions and painterly game-art finish. Do NOT redesign, add parts, remove parts, change core positions or change the item type.
Remove ALL of the existing gray/white checkerboard everywhere, including between separated parts and through silhouette openings. The checker pattern was an unwanted baked-in background, NOT part of the equipment.
Replace it with a fully OPAQUE near-black charcoal / midnight background, a very subtle dark warm amber aura behind the item and a few extremely restrained golden dust flecks, leaving excellent contrast. No transparency and absolutely no checkerboard or gray grid.
Uniformly scale the entire unchanged item down slightly so its WHOLE silhouette fits within 84 percent of the square image and no tip touches or clips an edge. Do not distort it.
Add one elegant thin straight square imperial gold double-line border near the outer edge of the canvas, consistent on all four sides. Small restrained crimson cabochon settings at the four corners. The frame must not overlap or obscure any part of the item. No crowns or large image decorations outside the gear itself. This is a matching premium equipment inventory icon, not a character card.
Square 1:1. No text, labels, numbers, logos, watermark, UI controls, human, body, hands or scenery. High-end Korean fantasy RPG inventory-art quality.
